Container.Name: vectorcraft-web
Container.Overview: VectorCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves the VectorCraft vector graphics editor through a browser-based WebAssembly application. Create and edit vector artwork directly in a modern browser. The application is rendered on the user's device using WebGPU where available, with WebGL2 as a fallback. The container only serves the static web application through NGINX; it does not provide a remote desktop, server-side graphics processing, or centralized artwork storage.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: VectorCraft Vector Craft Vector Graphics SVG Editor Drawing Illustration Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. The web interface is served over HTTP on container port 8080. WebGPU requires a secure browser context; use HTTPS through a reverse proxy such as Traefik for remote access. Browser and device support determine whether WebGPU or the WebGL2 fallback is used.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the VectorCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
